tasks.title: Set up Separation Architecture for Tumblr Posting Service
tasks.description: Design and establish the architecture to separate Tumblr-posting functionality from poeticalbot and listmania, creating an independent posting service with API access.
tasks.details:
This task involves designing a new architecture where Tumblr posting is handled by a dedicated service rather than being embedded in the poeticalbot and listmania applications.

1. Analyze the current Tumblr posting code in both projects to understand commonalities and differences
2. Design an API specification for how poeticalbot and listmania will communicate with the new posting service
   - Define required endpoints (e.g., /post, /schedule, /status)
   - Specify request/response formats in JSON
   - Design authentication mechanism (API keys)
   - Document rate limits and error handling
3. Create infrastructure diagrams showing the new component relationships
4. Select appropriate technology for the posting service:
   - Evaluate serverless options (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, etc.)
   - Consider container-based deployment if more control is needed
   - Determine hosting and scaling requirements
5. Set up a repository structure for the new posting service
6. Create a development roadmap for implementing the changes across all three services
7. Address data migration concerns if existing scheduled posts need to be transferred
8. Design monitoring and logging strategy for the new service architecture
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Create mockups of the API to validate the design before implementation
2. Develop API tests using Postman or similar tool that verify all planned endpoints
3. Set up integration tests that simulate poeticalbot and listmania making requests to the new posting service
4. Create test scenarios for authentication failures and API misuse
5. Test posting to a sandbox Tumblr account to verify end-to-end functionality
6. Verify logging and monitoring capture appropriate operational data
7. Conduct load testing to ensure the service can handle anticipated request volume
8. Perform security review of the API authentication mechanism

tasks.title: Document and Standardize Deployment Processes Across Applications
tasks.description: Analyze, document, and standardize deployment processes for listmania and poeticalbot applications, resolving conflicts between package.json scripts and shell scripts to create a clear deployment workflow.
tasks.details:
## Current Deployment Investigation
1. Analyze all deployment-related scripts in both applications:
   - Review package.json scripts in listmania and poeticalbot
   - Examine shell scripts (deploy.sh, build-lambda-package.sh)
   - Document the purpose and functionality of each script

2. Identify conflicts and inconsistencies:
   - Map out dependencies between scripts
   - Note redundant or contradictory script commands
   - Document environment-specific deployment variations

## Standardization and Resolution
1. Determine the optimal deployment process for each application:
   - Consider application architecture and hosting environment
   - Evaluate build requirements, deployment targets, and post-deployment steps
   - Design a clear sequential deployment workflow

2. Resolve conflicts:
   - Decide which scripts will be maintained vs. deprecated
   - Refactor package.json scripts for clarity and consistency
   - Update shell scripts to align with the standardized approach
   - Ensure proper script naming conventions and documentation

## Documentation Creation
1. Create comprehensive deployment documentation in each app's README:
   - Prerequisites (environment setup, credentials, etc.)
   - Step-by-step deployment instructions
   - Description of each script's purpose and when to use it
   - Troubleshooting section for common issues

2. Create deployment diagrams:
   - Visualize the deployment process flow
   - Show relationships between different scripts and environments
   - Indicate where manual intervention may be needed

## Implementation
1. Update scripts based on standardization decisions:
   - Refactor package.json scripts
   - Update shell scripts
   - Add inline documentation to scripts
   - Create helper scripts if needed to simplify complex processes

2. Prepare for future architecture changes:
   - Ensure documentation notes upcoming separation of Tumblr posting functionality
   - Flag scripts that will need updating after architecture changes
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verification Testing:
   - Perform test deployments for each application using only the documented steps
   - Verify that deployments succeed in development, staging, and production environments
   - Ensure all deployment artifacts are correctly generated and placed

2. Review Process:
   - Conduct a team review of the documentation for clarity and completeness
   - Have a team member unfamiliar with the deployment process attempt deployments using only the documentation
   - Collect feedback and refine documentation accordingly

3. Regression Testing:
   - Verify that applications function correctly after deployment using the standardized process
   - Run application-specific tests post-deployment to verify functionality
   - Check that no deployment steps or configurations are lost in the standardization

4. Documentation Validation:
   - Create a checklist of all deployment scenarios covered in documentation
   - Validate each scenario through actual execution
   - Ensure troubleshooting section addresses common failure points
